description: This file manages feature flag setup, synchronization, and updates within the Mattermost platform, including starting/stopping update jobs and handling configuration changes.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: A service class managing platform-specific operations, including feature flag synchronization.

methods.name: SetupFeatureFlags
methods.description: Initializes or stops feature flag synchronization based on configuration and leadership status.

methods.name: updateFeatureFlagValuesFromManagement
methods.description: Checks for changes in feature flags from the management service and updates configuration if needed.

methods.name: startFeatureFlagUpdateJob
methods.description: Starts a background job to periodically synchronize feature flags with the management service.

methods.name: StopFeatureFlagUpdateJob
methods.description: Stops the ongoing feature flag update job and cleans up resources.
